input.answer: The job vacancy rate for Canada in August 2026 was 2.9%, meaning about 2.9% of payroll jobs were unfilled. This is the all-industries figure from StatCan table 14-10-0371 (unadjusted for seasonality). July 2026 was 2.8% and June 2026 was 2.9%. The table's search card listed its range as ending 2026-07, but the series returned a value for 2026-08, so I used that value. I did not retrieve the seasonally adjusted version of this rate.

answer_values.description: Job vacancy rate, Canada, all industries, unadjusted for seasonality (share of payroll jobs unfilled), August 2026
